# American Hiking Society

> American Hiking Society protects hiking trails and outdoor spaces through advocacy, volunteer stewardship, and community engagement since 1976.

The organization connects hikers with trail maintenance opportunities, policy advocacy on Capitol Hill, and educational resources while building an inclusive hiking community. American Hiking Society operates flagship programs including National Trails Day, volunteer vacations, and ambassador initiatives across the United States.

## Key Topics

- Trail stewardship
- Volunteer opportunities
- Trail maintenance
- National Trails Day
- Public lands advocacy
- Conservation
- Hiking community
- NextGen Trail Leaders
- Volunteer vacations

- Alliance of Hiking Organizations
- Roadless Rule

## Advocacy & Policy

- [American Hiking Society - Advocacy](https://americanhiking.org/advocacy): Advocacy efforts with Congress on policy, legislation, and trail funding since 1976.
- [Get Involved - Advocate and Volunteer - American Hiking Society](https://americanhiking.org/get-involved): Central hub for volunteering, advocacy opportunities, and National Trails Day participation.

## Volunteer Programs & Trail Stewardship

- [Volunteer Vacations - American Hiking Society - Adventure Service Trips](https://americanhiking.org/volunteer-vacations): Week-long trail maintenance volunteer trips across Alaska and US Virgin Islands.
- [National Trails Day® - American Hiking Society - First Saturday in June](https://americanhiking.org/national-trails-day): National Trails Day event registration and stewardship campaign for June 6, 2026.
- [Ambassador Program - American Hiking Society](https://americanhiking.org/ambassador): NextGen Trail Leaders ambassador program for outdoor leadership and advocacy.
- [Alternative Break - American Hiking Society](https://americanhiking.org/volunteer-vacations/alternative-break): College student spring break alternative volunteer program for trail stewardship.
- [Crew Leader Training - American Hiking Society](https://americanhiking.org/crew-leader-training): Online certification course for trail crew leadership and volunteer training.

## Hiking Resources & Education

- [Hiking Resources - Hike with Confidence - American Hiking Society](https://americanhiking.org/hiking-resources): Hiking guides covering essentials, trail finding, and outdoor skills for confident hikers.

## Support & Membership

- [Ways to Give - American Hiking Society](https://americanhiking.org/ways-to-give): Donation methods including monthly giving, crypto, and membership options.
- [Register - American Hiking Society](https://americanhiking.org/join-donate/donate): Donation and membership registration supporting trail maintenance and advocacy.
- [Sponsors and Partners - American Hiking Society](https://americanhiking.org/sponsors): Corporate sponsorship and partnership opportunities for trail protection.

## About American Hiking Society

- [American Hiking Society - About US](https://americanhiking.org/about-us): Organizational mission, vision, values, and commitment to hiking community equity.
- [Our Team - American Hiking Society](https://americanhiking.org/about-us/our-team): Board of directors and staff leadership team information.
- [American Hiking Society - Protect the Places You Love to Hike](https://americanhiking.org): Homepage defining American Hiking Society's mission to protect trails and hiking experience.

## Community & Media

- [Share Your Tale from the Trail - American Hiking Society](https://americanhiking.org/share-your-story): User submission platform for hiking stories, photos, and video content.
- [Hiking Experts - American Hiking Society - Media Center](https://americanhiking.org/media-center): Media contact hub connecting journalists with hiking experts and resources.

## Optional

- [Financial Performance - American Hiking Society](https://americanhiking.org/about-us/financial-transparency): IRS Form 990 filings and annual reports for nonprofit accountability.
